identity.title: Giant galaxy growing from recycled gas: ALMA maps the circumgalactic molecular medium of the Spiderweb in [C I]
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: This is shown by observations of [C i], CO(1-0) and CO(4-3) performed with the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) and Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA).

evidence.quote: We assume H$_{0} = 71$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$, $\Omega_\textrm{M} = 0.27$ and $\Omega_{\Lambda} = 0.73$, i.e., 8.4 kpc/$^{\prime\prime}$ and $D_{\rm L} = 17309$ Mpc at z = 2.2 (EM16).

question.value: Is the cold molecular CGM of the Spiderweb Galaxy metal-rich and linked to in-situ star formation, and how do its [C I] and CO excitation compare to proto-cluster galaxies?

evidence.quote: Here we present observations sensitive to low-surface-brightness extended emission of atomic carbon, [C i] $^{3}$P$_{1}$-$^{3}$P$_{0}$ (hereafter [C i]) in the CGM of the Spiderweb Galaxy.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA$\#$2015.1.00851.S.

findings_qualitative.value: [CI] and CO(4-3) detected across ~50 kpc in CGM, ~30% of total flux on 17-70 kpc scales

evidence.quote: $\sim$30$\%$ of the total flux is spread on 17-70 kpc scales

claims.hypothesis: The molecular CGM is metal-rich and linked to in-situ star formation
claims.experiment: [CI], CO(4-3), CO(1-0) ratios and carbon abundance in CGM vs proto-cluster galaxies
claims.result: CGM ratios similar to proto-cluster galaxies; X[CI]/XH2 close to Milky Way
claims.finding: Molecular CGM is metal-rich and not diffuse

evidence.quote: The molecular CGM is thus metal-rich and not diffuse, confirming a link between the cold gas and *in-situ* star formation.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CGM gas mainly tidally stripped from proto-cluster galaxies is unlikely

evidence.quote: it is unlikely that the cold CGM consists mainly of gas that is currently being tidally stripped from proto-cluster galaxies

limitations_admitted.value: Beam-smearing errors prevented improving ATCA CO(1-0) over earlier work

evidence.quote: This prevented us from improving the image of the faint CO(1-0) in the halo compared with EM16.

reproducibility.score_reason: Archive data are available but processing details are sparse and the CO(1-0) data are ATCA.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Recipe is incomplete and relies on ATCA and VLA data.
